title: More options for text and vision
summary:
Qwen reasoning joined the model list, Mistral gained a vision-capable backend, and the text API got a cache Worker.

Added `qwen-reasoning` (Qwen QWQ 32B) through Groq and changed `mistral` to vision-capable Mistral Small 3.1 2503. Mistral-based personas use the new handler too.

Added a Python API example that sends a base64-encoded WAV file to `openai-audio` as `input_audio` and prints the transcription.

Added a text API Worker that can return cached responses from R2 and send cache misses to the origin. Image-request analytics also moved to the image cache Worker, where cache hits and generation outcomes can be recorded separately.

highlights.title: Qwen reasoning added
highlights.text: Use `qwen-reasoning` for Qwen QWQ 32B through the text API. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen-reasoning).

highlights.title: Mistral gets vision
highlights.text: `mistral` now uses vision-capable Mistral Small 3.1 2503. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral).
